convert_nlp_dataset: convert a HuggingFace nlp dataset script to TensorFlow Datasets format using regex transformations
create_dataset_template: create a TensorFlow Datasets template file from a HuggingFace nlp dataset source file
parse_cli_flags: parse command line flags for nlp_path, dataset_name, and dataset_type arguments
run_conversion_pipeline: run the full conversion pipeline from HuggingFace nlp to TensorFlow Datasets with CLI arguments
apply_regex_patterns: apply a list of regex patterns to transform nlp imports and API calls to tfds equivalents
